## Mandatory final stage: Documentation and Sync

- [ ] README and relevant docs match the behavior, configuration, and limitations changed by this PR, or explain why no documentation change is needed.
- [ ] Setup instructions and environment variable references are current if configuration changed.
- [ ] Documentation does not present planned or mocked integrations as implemented or live.
- [ ] Branch is rebased on the latest `origin/main`, conflicts are resolved without dropping other work, and applicable checks passed after synchronization.
- [ ] The PR description and checklist reflect the final implementation and verification results.
